title: Plugin server mode dispatch: index.ts createServer vs PluginServer fallback
answers: How does the plugin server choose what to run?
Where do I add a new server mode?
body:
- `nodejs/src/index.ts:createServer` switches on `defaultConfig.PLUGIN_SERVER_MODE` (enum `PluginServerMode` in `src/common/config.ts`).
- Most ingestion modes have a dedicated class in `src/servers/` (e.g. `IngestionGeneralServer`, `IngestionApiServer`, `IngestionSessionReplayServer`, `ErrorTrackingServer`, `RecordingApiServer`) sharing `NodeServer`/`ServerLifecycle` from `src/servers/base-server.ts`.
- `default:` branch returns `PluginServer` (`src/server.ts`): handles CDP modes, evaluation scheduler, local-dev combined modes. Its `startServices` only builds what `getPluginServerCapabilities` (`src/capabilities.ts`) enables; named groups like `CAPABILITIES_CDP` exist so dev can combine them.
- Shared infra lives in `src/common/` (config, Kafka, `IngestionOutputs`/`KafkaProducerRegistry`, PG/Redis pools, `TeamManager`).
